election.title: National parliament election in Sweden
election._seatsFixedComment: The Riksdag is fixed at 349, so an exit-poll seat projection must add up to it. Set false for a chamber whose size floats with overhang or levelling seats.

results._minValidVotesComment: Sweden 2022 counted about 6.5 million valid votes, so 100000 is far below any real count and far above the placeholder total of 8 the tab shipped with.

overrides._note: Taken from the Datawrapper charts so the page and the charts agree. Only these two differ from the europarty palette: C and L are both RE and M and KD are both EPP, so each pair would otherwise share one colour. S #ff0000, SD #0000ff, M #3399ff, V #990000, MP #009900 and L #ffd700 are the palette defaults and need no entry.

datawrapper._republishComment: Off on purpose. Every live chart here is linked to the Sheet, and its published bundle carries the export?format=csv URL, so the reader browser fetches the Sheet directly and data freshness does not depend on republishing. Republishing only created new versions, and the embed pins a version, so it silently left the page serving older renders — that happened to five charts. If a chart ever does look stale, republish it by hand and update its version here; check-embed.js compares the two.
